description: This file contains utility functions for SQL Lab in Apache Superset, including result limiting, IPC buffer writing, and user-specific data bootstrap.

classes.name: TabState
classes.description: Model representing the state of a SQL Lab tab.

methods.name: apply_display_max_row_configuration_if_require
methods.description: Limits the number of rows in SQL results and flags if limit is reached.

methods.name: write_ipc_buffer
methods.description: Serializes a pyarrow Table into an IPC buffer.

methods.name: bootstrap_sqllab_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns user-specific SQL Lab data including tabs and databases.
